topic.angle: How far the Nasdaq fell after its 2000 peak

card.title: How far the dot-com crash fell

body.question: The Nasdaq Composite rose by 600% between 1995 and its peak in March 2000. By October 2002, by about what percentage had it fallen from that peak?
body.reveal: About 78%. Between 1995 and its peak in March 2000 the Nasdaq Composite rose by 600%, then fell 78% from the peak by October 2002.

probes.question: By October 2002 the Nasdaq Composite had fallen by about what percentage from its March 2000 peak?
